typecheck.command: node next typegen; tsc --noEmit; tsc -p tsconfig.f2.json

format.command: full package format:check equivalent via pinned node

harness.command: python3 harness/scripts/sync.py --check; check.py; python3 -m unittest discover -s harness/scripts -p test_*.py -v

boundaries.history: R1 FAIL_SETUP fixture copied dependency symlink; local real dependencies resolved; product unchanged

canary.history: R2 invoked before dependency copy completed; module not found; setup resolved before R3

final_test_types_lint.command: tsc --noEmit; tsc -p tsconfig.f2.json; eslint final navigation spec --max-warnings=0
